# The research desk, killed while a claims run reads a page. The tree has three levels: the question run, one source run for each source, and one claims run for each source.
# The kill comes while the reader of the first source of section 1 runs in its claims run, so the question run and the source run wait in gather.
# A second beehave run continues the item. After the restart, every run ends once, no child run starts twice, each agent runs once and the report is published once.
[!exec:jq] skip
isolate
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

rdinit
rdfakes
env HOME=$WORK/home
env RESEARCH_DESK_DIR=$WORK/rd
env RESEARCH_HOME=$WORK/store
env SEARCH_API=http://search.test
env WIKI_API=http://wiki.test
env RESEARCH_HEADER_FILE=$WORK/home/.research/credential.header

exec beehavereal check workflow rd/workflow.star
! stdout .
! stderr .

exec beehavereal item add research-desk cold-cost --title 'Cold and cost' --body-file body.txt
! exec sh first.sh run cold-cost research-desk --workflow rd/workflow.star &
# The fake reader writes held when the first claims run asks for it, and waits. The page of the first source was fetched before.
waitfile held
kill -KILL
wait
cmp held expected-held
grep -count=1 '^plan$' calls.log

exec beehavereal run cold-cost research-desk --workflow rd/workflow.star &
waitstatus 'paused: Review the draft report of cold-cost'
exec beehavereal answer cold-cost approve
wait
stdout 'item cold-cost finished'

# The runs are the question run, and for each of the four sources one source run and one claims run. Each is done once, and no run follows them.
exec beehavereal status
stdout -count=9 '^item-.*-r1\tdone'
stdout -count=1 'item-cold-cost-r1\tdone'
stdout -count=1 'item-research-desk-2-r1\tdone'
stdout -count=1 'item-research-desk-3-r1\tdone'
stdout -count=1 'item-research-desk-4-r1\tdone'
stdout -count=1 'item-research-desk-5-r1\tdone'
stdout -count=1 'item-research-desk-6-r1\tdone'
stdout -count=1 'item-research-desk-7-r1\tdone'
stdout -count=1 'item-research-desk-8-r1\tdone'
stdout -count=1 'item-research-desk-9-r1\tdone'
! stdout 'research-desk-10'
! stdout 'r2\t'

# Each page got one id in the store, so no source run fetched a page twice under another id.
grep -count=2 '^s' store/cold-cost/sources.tsv
! grep '^s3' store/cold-cost/sources.tsv

# Each agent ran once, the plan and the sections as in the uncrashed desk. The report was published once, and the page holds the same text.
cmp calls.log expected-calls.log
grep -count=1 '^cold-cost-' wiki.log
cmp store/cold-cost/report.md wiki.page

-- first.sh --
# The first run exec's beehave, so the kill stops beehave itself.
exec beehavereal "$@"
-- hold --
-- body.txt --
How does the cold change the output of a unit, and what does it cost?
-- expected-held --
read cold
-- expected-calls.log --
plan
read cold
read cold
judge
write Output
read cost
read cost
judge
write Cost
abstract
-- home/.research/credential.header --
Authorization: Bearer TESTONLY
-- resp/_search --
{"results":[{"url":"http://pages.test/page/a"},{"url":"http://pages.test/page/b"}]}
-- resp/_page_a --
<p>Winter tests. At -20 C the output fell by 30 percent.</p>
-- resp/_page_b --
<p>The unit costs 12 euro per month.</p>
